from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

# Instantiate the loader with "./src" as the search path
loader = GriffeLoader(search_paths=["./src"])

# Load the package
mypkg = loader.load("mypkg")

# Resolve all aliases that were recorded during loading
loader.resolve_aliases()

print(f"Successfully loaded package: {mypkg.name}")
print(f"Members: {list(mypkg.members.keys())}")
